entries.notes: WF-RUST-099 is fixed in both the active TypeScript cache and production Rust. Both bind workflow/event keys to exact original bytes, share in-flight work for identical bytes, reject mismatches without preparing the conflicting payload, preserve terminal conflicts across in-flight completion and later lookup, reject same-key preparer re-entry, and expose only fixed redacted diagnostics. TypeScript copies identity and preparation buffers separately and publishes the entry before invoking custom preparation code. The permanent Rust-core workflow must keep the TypeScript regression and both production Rust replay-cache targets green.
